verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS observability platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence shows a first-party Datadog MCP Server docs page (docs-3, with an agent-readable markdown version in docs-34), and a probe confirmed it is officially documented (probe-3). The pack contains only titles and a probe hit, with no detail on how an agent connects. Missing for 10: documented tool/capability list, auth and client-setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully.
